name: Backlog CLI: Graph-Based Item Backlog Management
description: Graph-backed backlog management system with 34 CLI commands for CRUD, query, lifecycle management, multi-agent coordination, and markdown interop. CLI, MCP server, and HTTP server all mounted live via apigen — no code generation.
receipts: entrypoint/backlog/src/store/*.ts (17 store files: crud, claim, lifecycle, structure, query, audit-log, ids, mapping)
signature_note: SQLite-backed graph store with bi-temporal history, audit-log event system, FTS5 dedupe/query, concurrency-safe lock-free CAS for 20-worker race-free id allocation, atomic file-lock-protected published-state cache. 3 transports (CLI, HTTP/Fastify+OpenAPI, MCP stdio) mounted live via apigen extract()->composeSchemas()->plugin.run() — no codegen. UPSERT import-from-markdown with ownership-gated cross-file updates. Eager-open avoidance: lazy store activation only on first real command.

name: Backlog HTTP Server (Fastify + OpenAPI)

name: Backlog MCP Server (stdio)

name: Backlog Migration System (Phase-3 Active)

signature_note: 5-phase migration (not-started→complete) with per-phase tool-authoritative semantics, global config persistence via writeMigrationPhase, installable agent skill for MCP tool discovery, parity-check projection verify gate.

name: Backlog Graph Store (SQLite + SOX)
description: SQLite-backed graph store using @adhd/sox-graph-store for nodes, edges, FTS5 search, bi-temporal invalidation. Supports 20-worker concurrent CAS, audit-log event nodes, dependency graph traversal, plan-scoped projections.
signature_note: Concurrent id allocation with CAS (resolve+insert inside .immediate() transaction), bounded jittered exponential backoff for SQLITE_BUSY, audit-log event nodes immune to metadata replace, FTS5 sanitize with Unicode-aware allowlist, content-immutability fix for FTS re-sync on edit.

name: Build Tooling: Custom Nx Executors (@adhd/nx-build, @adhd/nx-deps, @adhd/nx-assets, @adhd/nx-test, @adhd/nx-secret-scan)
description: 5 custom Nx plugins with 10+ executors: version (cache-driven bump decision with published-state.json), publish (cache-check before npm publish, write-through on success), reconcile (integrity-gated npm cache backfill), manifest (dist package.json generation), verify-dist-load (dist entry load verification), hygiene (npm-pack allowlist gate), sync-deps (dependency range reconciliation), sync-deps-check, assets-copy (README/CHANGELOG to dist), secret-scan (credential detection).
signature_note: Published-state cache: zero-network version bump decision (1166× faster than tarball-fetch), normalizedHash equivalence-proof suite, atomic O_CREAT|O_EXCL lockfile for concurrent-safe parallel nx run-many writes, integrity-gated reconcile (metadata compare before tarball pull), CPU-usage guard in withMetrics, vitest thread-pool bounding for CPU oversubscription prevention.

name: Vite Externalize Plugin (externalize.mjs)
description: Vite/rollup plugin computing build-time externalization lists from real dependency trees. Externalizes only non-@adhd/* deps and Node builtins; @adhd/* workspace packages stay bundled to work around @adhd's no-workspace-linking architecture. Used by >30 vite.config.ts files.
signature_note: Resolves the full transitive @adhd/* dependency tree via computeRealDependencyNames. Critical for all packages — without it, bundled @adhd/* imports break at runtime.

name: Published-State Cache (published-state.json)
description: Committed cache of 54 published npm packages with {version, normalizedHash, publishedIntegrity}. Provides zero-network version-bump decisions and existence checks. Concurrency-safe via atomic file lock.
signature_note: normalizedHash proven equivalent to full per-file tarball diff (compare-published.spec.mjs includes both-direction equivalence proof + range-move-but-hash-equal + code-change-hash-different cases).

name: Metrics Framework (withMetrics + CPU Guard)
description: Centralized per-task-run performance recording for all custom Nx executors. Records wall time, named sub-phase timings, subprocess spawn count+ms per command, network call count, and CPU% usage. Includes CPU-usage guard that fails tasks exceeding ADHD_NX_METRICS_MAX_CPU_PCT (default 300%).
verified_output:
ℹ tests 38
ℹ pass 38
ℹ fail 0
signature_note: Instrumented across 10+ executors with zero boilerplate per-executor; concurrency-safe append via atomic lockfile with stale-lock recovery; bounded log growth (5000 records). CPU guard runs independently of recording (ADHD_NX_METRICS=0 disables recording while guard stays active).
